# id: PG-gate-54-research
# covers: PG 184 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek researches at the Research Bench (job); research status raw progress points of the first queued tech per
#   30-game-minute window at speed 3. research start any 3 queues up to 3 techs the game would
#   start now (longest first); the first is measured; progress resets to the next tech
#   when one completes (then that window's BAL2 is invalid: P1 < P0).
# verify: progress rises in every window (else no power/bench level: research status desk_level/benches);
#   own50 > none = research reads the hooked Science (ResearchBuilding::operate is not scaled by PG).
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
power "Research Bench" supply radius 60
fill "Research Bench" "Book" 40 radius 60 topup
research status
research start any 3 ~ started=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
job Avarek "Research Bench" radius 60
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 600
speed 0
# --- g1: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek science 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek science ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
research status ~ ^(?!.*power_off)
building "Research Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set P0 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@echo POST
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
@set P1 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,184,science,25,0,none,g1,research,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g2: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Avarek science 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" science 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek science ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
research status ~ ^(?!.*power_off)
building "Research Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set P0 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@echo POST
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
@set P1 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,184,science,25,50,own50,g2,research,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g3: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek science 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek science ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
research status ~ ^(?!.*power_off)
building "Research Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set P0 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@echo POST
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
@set P1 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,184,science,90,0,none,g3,research,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g4: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek science 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek science ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek

@sleep 3

@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1

building "Research Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set P0 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek science
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900

stat Avarek science
@echo POST
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)

@set P1 research status ~ raw=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,184,science,25,0,none,g4,research,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
research status
clearjobs Avarek
